title: GEDO Memory Pack — manifest.json
description: Top-level metadata for a .gmp pack. MUST exist at the root of the ZIP container.

uid_hash.description: SHA-256(uid || uid_salt) hex-lowercase. Never put a raw user id here.

uid_salt.description: Hex-encoded random salt used in uid_hash. Optional but recommended.

display_name.description: Self-declared name of the owner. Importers MUST treat this as untrusted.

public_key.description: Owner's Ed25519 public key, base64-encoded. Used to verify 'signature'.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when this pack was generated.

stats.description: Quick counts. Importers MAY use these for progress UI but MUST recount after parsing.

encryption.description: Encryption mode applied to non-manifest files inside the pack.

encryption_recipients.description: age recipient strings; required when encryption == 'age-x25519'.

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical JSON of this manifest with 'signature' removed. Format: '<algo>:<base64>'.

extra.description: Vendor-specific extension bag. MUST be ignored by other implementations if unknown.
